nom: TONYMOLY Wonder Ceramide Mochi Micellar Foam Cleanser

segments.oily: Most reviewers with oily skin, including some who call their T-zone oily, say the foam cleanses away excess oil and grease without the dryness they expect from other foam cleansers, though a couple find it only average for oil control or suggest pairing it with a heavier cleanser for a deeper clean.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are divided: several say it can be drying or too strong for dry skin and recommend a richer cleanser or careful moisturizing afterward, while others with dry skin report being pleasantly surprised that it left their skin hydrated rather than tight or dry.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, several of whom also describe themselves as acne-prone or sensitive, say the formula balances their skin without feeling heavy and cleanses gently without triggering breakouts.
segments.sensitive: The great majority of reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive, including several who call it 'very' or 'super' sensitive, report no irritation, stinging, or redness, with many specifically choosing this cleanser because other foaming cleansers strip or irritate their skin.

concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers say the foam cleanses without stripping, tightness, or dryness, and several specifically highlight it leaving skin hydrated or plump afterward; a smaller number, mostly those with already-dry skin, say it can be drying or too strong without a good follow-up moisturizer.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers with redness-prone skin say the cica and centella asiatica in the formula calm existing redness with use, and none in this set report the cleanser itself causing new redness or irritation.
concerns.barrier: Multiple reviewers cite the ceramides in the formula as strengthening or protecting the skin barrier, and describe the cleanser as never leaving skin feeling stripped, which they connect to that barrier-supportive claim.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers, including some who say almost everything else breaks them out, report fewer breakouts, improved hormonal or active acne, and no new blemishes with regular use; one reviewer, however, says it gave her small, non-inflamed bumps on her forehead that cleared up once she stopped using it.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin or an oily T-zone say the foam removes excess oil and grease and leaves skin looking clearer, though one notes it only did an average job of controlling her oily skin's shine.

aspects.libelle: One pump goes a long way
Scent can read as chemical to some

extraits.texte: I use a medical grade skincare cleanser but was tired of double cleansing with something so expensive, so I bought this to get the bulk of my makeup off first. Unfortunately, the smell is gross and it gave me bumps on my forehead. Not pimples or irritation— just small bumps in the skin. Once I went back to my expensive stuff only, the bumps cleared up. Bummer, will be returning.

The Wonder Ceramide Gentle Foam Cleanser gifted by tonymoly effectively cleanses without stripping oils, making it ideal for thorough cleansing. However, its formulation can be drying for those with dry skin, necessitating careful moisturization post-use.

I have acne prone combo skin that is very sensitive. I use the Peach & Lily cleanser but needed something cheaper for the moment so I decided to try this. I noticed right away it has a very airy, fluffy foam which I liked. I don't need much. It did effectively remove my makeup, mascara included very easily. I always double cleanse with a balm but wanted to really test it out. It also has the same fresh, citrus scent that their mochi ceramide cream has. It's subtle and I don't mind. It can be a tad more drying than the P&L but doesn't feel right if you don't use too much. I noticed with just the few times I've used it so far, my advice acne has already improved. It has niacinamide which I love. The P&L is a pretty basic cleanser so I love that it includes the niacinamide for my acne. Given the price I make actually switch from the P&L due to the price and the Tony Moly having lore to offer as far as ingredients!

I recently tried the Tony Moly Wonder Ceramide Mochi Gentle Foam Cleanser, and I am thoroughly impressed. From the first use, I noticed how incredibly soft and plush the foam felt against my skin. As someone with sensitive skin, I was relieved to find that this cleanser is as gentle as advertised. The combination of Ceramides and Collagen really works wonders, leaving my skin feeling plump and hydrated after each wash. The inclusion of Niacinamide and Centella Asiatica (Cica) Extract has been a game-changer for calming and soothing my skin. Any redness I had seemed to diminish significantly. I also appreciate the added benefits from Aloe Leaf Extract and Olive Oil, which contribute to a nourishing and moisturizing cleanse without any greasy residue. At 150ml, the cleanser is a decent size, ensuring it will last a good while even with daily use. The experience of using this product is truly luxurious, living up to its promise of making my skin feel as soft and smooth as mochi. Overall, the Tony Moly Ceramide Cleanser has become a staple in my skincare routine, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a gentle yet effective cleansing solution. Gifted by Tonymoly.

Love the how soft and fluffy the foam is coming out of the bottle. The foam feels super comfortable and gentle on the skin. However, it does cleanser vey well – my t-zone can be oily and this removes all the grease. It has a light scent that's pleasant. I think it would be suitable for most skin types. (Gifted by Wonder for my honest opinions).

extraits.titre: Truly impressed. So good for dry skin
extraits.texte: This cleanser is Amazing! The bottle is great to use. The texture is soft as a cloud. It cleans my skin very well. When I have redness it calms them somehow. It doesn't make my skin dry, even more it deeply hydrated it. And it smells so good.

I highly recommend this product for those with combination skin. The formula is lightweight yet effective, making it ideal for balancing the skin without feeling heavy. If you have dry skin, you may prefer a richer cleanser for added hydration. For oily skin types, pairing this with a heavier cleanser, such as an oil-based cleanser, can help maintain balance since this product cleanses gently without removing a lot of oil.
